lines.text: Commander. Your legion awaits orders. Here's how you give them.
Vibius Maximus is a small Windows companion for vibe coding, where you build software by telling AI what you want.
Speak instead of typing. Show your screen instead of describing it. Fire your best prompts with a single key.
Clearer orders, so your legion builds exactly what you mean.
Built on open source: Handy, Excalidraw and xcap.
First, arm your legion. On first launch, choose Canary 180M Flash, the recommended model.
One small download, and your voice never leaves your PC.
First, click where the words should go.
Then hold Control Space and give the order. Let go, and the text lands at your cursor, offline, in any app.
Rather not hold? Tap to start, tap to stop, or choose Auto, Hold or Toggle in Settings.
Click where it should go, like your terminal. Alt S freezes the screen. Drag over what to change.
Number shapes is on by default. Every box, circle or arrow you draw gets the next number, and its own note.
Just want to mark a spot? Press Alt and the backtick key, then click. A pin drops a number, with nothing drawn.
Text you write on the shot is just a label. It never gets a number.
Say a note for each, and hold Control Space for the main order.
Rambled? Alt D tidies the wording.
Control Enter sends it to the window you clicked before Alt S. The button names it, so check it before you send.
Terminals get a file path for Claude Code. Clicked a chat box? The image and notes land there.
Not sending yet? Alt C copies it all.
Alt V, in any app, delivers the image and the text.
Double-click any capture to open it again.
Click your destination, then Alt B opens the board.
Now capture each screen with Alt S, and Alt Enter adds it to the board instead of sending it.
Write between them, then circle and pin what matters.
Control Enter sends every image in order, labelled to match your prompt.
And every campaign is kept.
Standing orders are your own prompt templates, each on a hotkey, and five starters ship as a workflow.
Alt 1 to 5 runs the whole campaign: research, summarize, plan, scope, execute.
They're yours to rewrite. Open one and change the wording, or add your own, like a code review on Alt 6.
Then fire it in any app. Type the ask, press Alt 4, and a full spec comes back.
Alt 5 hands that spec to builder agents, and a reviewer checks the evidence.
Five to start, and as many as you need.
Every key at its post, and every one yours to change.
Light enough to march anywhere.
Vibius Maximus. Veni, vidi, vibed.
